market.val: $333.44/MW-day UCAP RTO-wide (FERC price cap); 134479 MW UCAP procured; total cleared value approximately $16.4 billion
market.limits: Delivery Year June 1 2027 to May 31 2028; first auction where RTO-wide cleared capacity fell short of the reliability requirement (short by 6623 MW)

market.n: Capacity Performance Non-Performance Charge and Bonus (Performance Assessment)
market.struct: Non-Performance Charge Rate applied per MW of shortfall during Performance Assessment Intervals; funds bonus payments to over-performing resources; rate derived from Net CONE divided by an EFORd-adjusted reserve factor
market.val: Aggregated Non-Performance Charges across 2025 Performance Assessment events estimated by PJM at $1 billion to $2 billion system-wide; per-resource Non-Performance Charge Rate not independently confirmed for current Delivery Year
market.limits: Assessed per 5-minute interval during any Performance Assessment Hour (Emergency or Pre-Emergency Load Management event); Stop-Loss provisions cap annual non-performance exposure at a multiple of a resource's weekly capacity revenue
market.tariff: OATT Attachment DD Section 10A; Manual 18 Section 4

market.struct: Value captured from charging during low-LMP hours and discharging during high-LMP hours measured as the daily top-4-hour minus bottom-4-hour (TB4) spread net of round-trip efficiency losses
market.val: PJM-wide average TB4 spread rose from about $46699/MW-yr in 2024 to about $69375/MW-yr in 2025 (a 49% year-over-year increase); highest spreads concentrated in Northern Virginia and Eastern Maryland (Dominion BGE PEPCO zones); lowest spreads in New Jersey zones (PSEG JCPL) due to export constraints
market.limits: Captured through day-ahead and real-time LMP differentials; no PJM-imposed cap on participation; subject to nodal congestion and export limits

market.struct: $/MWh payment for offline or fast-start capacity deliverable within 10 minutes co-optimized with energy and Synchronized Reserve
market.val: Not independently confirmed for 2026; cleared jointly with Synchronized Reserve under PJM's 2023 reserve price formation reform
market.limits: 10-minute response requirement; consolidated Tier 1/Tier 2 procurement aligned across Day-Ahead and Real-Time markets under the 2023 reserve reform

market.struct: $/MW-day capacity payment cleared alongside generation in BRA; same CP performance obligation applies
market.val: Same cleared BRA price as generation capacity ($329.17/MW-day RTO for 2026/2027 DY)
market.limits: Annual DR must be available year-round; Limited DR covers June-Sept weekdays; Extended Summer DR covers May-Sept; all DR products require minimum 10-consecutive-hour sustained reduction capability since Capacity Performance eliminated Base Capacity
market.tariff: OATT Attachment DD Section 5.5A; Manual 18 Section 4
market.stack: Economic Load Response;Emergency Load Response;Synchronized Reserve

market.struct: Capability payment equals Cleared MW times RMCCP times Performance Score; Performance payment equals Cleared MW times Mileage Ratio times RMPCP times Performance Score; plus a Lost Opportunity Cost payment; RegA is the slower steady signal historically used by thermal generation
market.val: 2023 average Regulation Market Clearing Price (RMCP) was approximately $21.08/MW; RegA generally clears at a lower dollar-per-effective-MW rate than RegD
market.limits: Continuous 5-minute AGC dispatch signal; performance scored every 5 minutes on precision delay and correlation; RegA/RegD dual-signal design is being replaced by a single unified signal starting October 2025 with a full Regulation-Up/Regulation-Down split by October 2026

market.struct: Performance payment equals Cleared MW times Mileage Ratio times RMPCP times Performance Score; Capability payment equals Cleared MW times RMCCP times Performance Score where RMCCP equals RMCP minus RMPCP; plus Lost Opportunity Cost equals Estimated Missed Energy Revenue times Performance Score
market.val: RegD has historically driven over 80% of PJM battery revenue; in Q1 2025 97% of cleared RegD MW had $0 effective-cost self-scheduled bids and batteries scored 91-100% performance in 92% of operating hours; RegD's mileage-based rate per effective MW has been more than double RegA's in some months
market.limits: Continuous 5-minute fast-following signal optimized for batteries; the Marginal Benefit Factor used to clear the market versus the Mileage Ratio used to pay for it creates a payment premium the PJM Market Monitor argues overstates RegD's system value; a single unified signal replaces RegA/RegD starting October 2025 with a Reg-Up/Reg-Down split by October 2026
market.tariff: OATT Schedule 1; Manual 28 Regulation Redesign sections

market.struct: $/MW-day UCAP capacity payment cleared in Base Residual Auction; single year-round CP product
market.val: Set by BRA clearing price (see BRA rows); bounded by FERC-approved Market Seller Offer Cap tied to Net ACR
market.limits: Must perform during all Performance Assessment Hours across the Delivery Year; 24x365 obligation; no seasonal or hourly call cap

market.struct: $/MWh payment for reserve capacity deliverable within 30 minutes
market.val: Not independently confirmed for 2026; published via PJM Data Miner 2 Day-Ahead Ancillary Service LMPs feed
market.limits: 30-minute response requirement

market.struct: $/MWh capacity payment cleared in the 10-minute co-optimized reserve market; Tier 1 is spare energy from online resources deliverable within 10 minutes while Tier 2 is called only when Tier 1 is insufficient
market.val: Clearing prices vary by hour and reserve zone and were not independently confirmed for 2026; PJM added a 30% adder to the Synchronized Reserve requirement in May 2023 after under-performance during reserve events
market.limits: Must respond within 10 minutes and sustain for the event duration; deployed via a PJM-declared Synchronized Reserve Event
